For [filesystem](/docs/shell/commands/categories/filesystem/).

<div class='command-title'>Manage in-memory file index state.</div>

## Command Type

`built-in`

## Signature

```> idx {flags} ```


## Input/output types:

| input   | output |
| ------- | ------ |
| nothing | string |
## Notes
Use one of the subcommands: init, status, find, search, watch, drop, dirs, files. By default `idx init` enables filesystem watching so the index updates as files change; pass `--no-watch` for a static index. Use `idx watch` to stream change events from that live index into a pipeline.

## Subcommands:

| name                                         | description                                                             | type     |
| -------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- |
| [`idx dirs`](/docs/shell/commands/idx_dirs/)     | List indexed directories, or fuzzy-match directories by query.          | built-in |
| [`idx drop`](/docs/shell/commands/idx_drop/)     | Drop the current idx runtime from memory.                               | built-in |
| [`idx files`](/docs/shell/commands/idx_files/)   | List indexed files, or fuzzy-match files by query.                      | built-in |
| [`idx find`](/docs/shell/commands/idx_find/)     | Search idx with fuzzy matching across files and directories by default. | built-in |
| [`idx init`](/docs/shell/commands/idx_init/)     | Initialize the in-memory idx index for a path.                          | built-in |
| [`idx search`](/docs/shell/commands/idx_search/) | Search indexed file contents.                                           | built-in |
| [`idx status`](/docs/shell/commands/idx_status/) | Show status information for the global in-memory idx runtime.           | built-in |
| [`idx watch`](/docs/shell/commands/idx_watch/)   | Stream filesystem change events from the live idx index.                | built-in |
